moments.author: Dave Chappelle
moments.quote: Ever since that guy Charlie Kirk got murdered … I feel better
moments.why: A dark, leaked punchline went viral and triggered a massive backlash from public figures and media.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: The tech billionaire’s public rebuke amplified the controversy around Chappelle’s joke.

moments.author: Caleb Williams
moments.quote: Wearing cleats from a small brand, billions in free ad after Bears game
moments.why: His use of a little-known shoe brand during a high‑profile game gave the company media‑worthy exposure and conversation.

moments.author: CBS / 60 Minutes (as quoted from President Trump)
moments.quote: If we don't have it, China's going to have it… I don't want to put us in a deep second position
moments.why: A clip of Trump discussing AI and competition with China on 60 Minutes is trending widely on social media.
